notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Change Log


 Game difficulty added in Settings menu. This modifies the burn rate of all fires.

 Very Easy burns at 0.35 times normal speed.
 Easy burns at 0.7 times normal speed.
 Normal is the original burn rate.
 Hard burns at 1.5 times normal speed.
 Impossible burns at 2.5 times normal speed.

 Player rotation reworked. Upper torso will now rotate towards the cursor at all times.

 This fixes a bug where the hose nozzle could block water at extreme angles.
 Axe now accurately hits the cursor target.

 Music and Effects volume controls moved from General tab to new Sound tab in Settings menu.


 Level Changes

 Mansion

 Metal door to security room locked. This was unintentionally unlocked in update 1.1.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Change Log

 Water Shield Reworked. 

 Active up to 12 seconds.
 Length increased with water spray.
 Fade out effect added as visual cue of time remaining.
 Walls and floors now show water shield.

 Wooden doors are now destructible.

 Requires 7 hits (compared to 4 for Walls and Windows).

 Contraband cooldown period added

 5 second cooldown period after dropping loot.
 Guards will stop searching for the player after the cooldown ends if the player is not holding any other loot.
 Selling loot to the Shady Guy skips the cooldown period for the sold items.
 Minimap now flashes blue and red while player is holding contraband, and drains colour to show remaining cooldown period.

 Bug fixes

 Fixed bug that caused garage doors to not block water spray
 Fixed bug that allowed a hose to move through walls when near a one-way door.
 Fixed placement bug when dropping the Backpack in Arcade level.



Level Changes

 Arcade

 'Employees Only' sign on storeroom door now destructible.

 Warehouse

 Increased extinguish objective from 25% burnt to 35% burnt.
 Changed NPC fireman to stand closer to the fire once lured into the warehouse.
 Increased victim health from 1000 from 3000. 
 Door changed to metal and locked to prevent bypassing guards.
 Added objective to spread fire to nearby stacks as presented in cinematic.

 House

 Oven fire spread radius reduced from 600 to 500.

 Car Crash

 Extinguish objective increased from 50% burnt to 60% burnt.

 Farm

 Barn door updated to a metal texture, with axe impact fx feedback.
 Extinguish objective increased from 25% burnt to 30% burnt.

 Mansion

 Bedroom and Study doors changed to metal doors to prevent destruction.

 Police Station

 Jail and evidence locker doors changed to metal doors to prevent destruction.



Comments
The change to the water shield has reduced the difficulty of most levels. Please share your experiences in the Steam discussion forum on level difficulty, especially any difficulty spikes that need attention. Hope you have fun fighting fires and running away with the loot.
